Video logs: before & after, on every job

The shop records a short video at intake and another when the work is done. The customer sees the car's condition before a wrench is turned and the finished work after. The shop never eats a "that dent was already there" dispute. Drag the scrubber across the sample job.

  • Transparency the customer can see

    No more "trust us, it was like that." The intake frame is timestamped and stored on the repair order.

  • Liability protection for the shop

    Pre-existing damage is on record before the job starts, so disputes end at the video, not in an argument.

  • Proof that sells the next job

    Finished-work frames show the repair, not a description of it. They live in the customer's portal.

Estimates approved online. Profit visible per job.

No more estimates lost in a text thread. The customer opens the estimate, approves it with one tap, and the job moves to Parts. Behind it, parts and sublet costs are logged against the same repair order, so the shop sees its real profit, not just its revenue.
